🐟 Directorate of Fisheries, Panaji – Goa has announced a Walk-In-Interview for the post of Sagar Mitra on a contract basis.

Post Name:Sagar Mitra

Total Vacancies: 38

Appointment Period: Contract basis (1st Nov 2026 to 31st Dec 2026 till continuation of scheme)

Educational Qualification: Bachelor degree in Fisheries Science / Marine Biology / Zoology OR 12th passed in Science stream

Additional Requirements:Knowledge of Information Technology and Konkani

Age Limit: Not exceeding 35 years

Consolidated Pay: ₹10,000 plus additional incentives up to ₹5,000 per month

🗓️ Walk-In-Interview Details:

Date: 28th October 2026

Time: 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM

 📝 How to Apply:

Interested candidates should submit an application on plain paper with a recent colour passport-size photograph pasted on the right side, along with details including full name, present and permanent address, contact numbers, nationality, date of birth, educational and additional qualifications, 15-year residence certificate, and employment registration number, supported by attested copies.

Official Website: fisheries.goa.gov.in

Source: Navhind Times (24-10-2026)
